cohort: Neonates admitted to the NICU of Cairo University Children's Hospital (CUCH) between September 2017 and August 2018 with manifestations of hemodynamic instability, regardless of gestational age, weight, gender, or type of disease.
finding: Decreases in EF, FS, TAPSE, and MAPSE are late signs of hemodynamic instability in neonates <= 1500 g, while TAPSE and MAPSE are the earliest parameters to decrease in hemodynamically unstable neonates > 1500 g.
birth_weight: All birth weights included, with analysis stratified by 1500g
